description: Every AI+ version saved on one shot (natural motion and VFX), newest first: its number, what made it (the prompt or the VFX), which one plays now, whether it fits the shot's current length, and how the person rated it. Switching to a saved version uses no credit (use_ai_version); a new one uses 1 AI+ credit (regenerate_ai_version).

photoId.description: A photo: its photoId from the edit summary, or its play position like "shot 3".
